State-wise Monthly GST Refund Disbursements (2020–2026)

Source: R/data.R
gst_refunds.Rd

Monthly refunds disbursed per state/UT and component, covering FY 2020-21 through FY 2025-26. Values in Rs. Crore.

gst_refunds

Format

A data.table with 2,911 rows and 11 columns:

financial_year

character. Financial year.

month

character. Month in "YYYY-MM".

month_date

Date. First day of the month.

state_code

character. GST state code.

state

character. State/UT name.

region

character. Geographic region.

cgst

numeric. CGST refund (Rs. Crore).

sgst

numeric. SGST refund (Rs. Crore).

igst

numeric. IGST refund (Rs. Crore).

cess

numeric. Cess refund (Rs. Crore).

total

numeric. Total refund (Rs. Crore).

Source

Ministry of Finance, Government of India. https://www.gst.gov.in

Examples

data(gst_refunds)
gst_refunds[financial_year == "2023-24",
            .(total_refund = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE)), by = state][order(-total_refund)]
